_note: Original to Arda. Flavour backgrounds for class builds; each grants two SRD skills and nothing else.

agriculture.name: Furrow-Born
agriculture.text: Raised to the rhythm of sowing and harvest.

craft.name: Bench-Trained
craft.text: Learned a trade at a master's elbow, one ruined piece at a time.

trade.name: Ledger-Keeper
trade.text: Grew up among scales, tallies and hard bargains.

service.name: Hearth-Keeper
service.text: Knows every regular's drink and every stranger's story.

religion.name: Temple-Raised
religion.text: Swept temple floors long before leading its prayers.

military.name: Wall-Sworn
military.text: Took the garrison's oath young and has kept watch ever since.

government.name: Seal-Bearer
government.text: Carries the small authority of office and the large weight of it.

maritime.name: Tide-Hand
maritime.text: Reads the water and the weather before reading anything else.

extraction.name: Deep-Delver
extraction.text: Has spent more days under stone or bough than under open sky.

scholar.name: Lamp-Reader
scholar.text: Has read by lamplight every night since learning letters.

labour.name: Cobble-Walker
labour.text: Knows every alley, back door and shortcut in town.

nobility.name: Landed Heir
nobility.text: Born to a name that opens doors and invites grudges.

dependent.name: Hearth-Born
dependent.text: Has lived a quiet life close to home.
